a: Panels: up to $500,000/yr for 3 years, at most 2 awards each
dt: Analog/natural-systems computing panel: pre-application by Nov 22, 2026. Quantum routing panel: pre-application by Jan 10, 2027. Other topics are open year-round.
e: ASCR runs two panels with required pre-applications: one on foundations of analog computing and computing with physical systems, and one on quantum routing for fault-tolerant hardware. It also accepts year-round applications on quantum computing and networking software, testbeds and microelectronics for scientific computing. U.S. universities may apply.
n: DOE ASCR Quantum Computing, Quantum Routing, Analog Computing & Advanced Computing Technologies panels – FY2027 Open Call
unv: The ACT topic excludes developing new physical qubits.
